raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17, payments-source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records and no longer updates the original, so reversed originals still have status POSTED and silver_transactions counts them, inflating the gold totals. The fix is to exclude any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL record points to via orig_txn_id; this assumes each reversal fully offsets its original amount, which the evidence does not confirm.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
